answer: Clawback-vesting at the tide: payouts unlock over 30 epochs, and any identity proven sybil forfeits all pending balance. The atlas tracks a collateral-weighted graph so linked identities share one vesting pool. Honest players face zero cost; a farm of n identities must lock n×stake for 30 epochs, and the reef of delayed liquidity means exit-before-detection is impossible. Cost scales linearly, reward sublinearly — sybil returns go negative.
